item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes a prior national security memorandum, an internal executive-policy and administrative instrument; this is an executive-management change rather than a direct alteration of private legal rights.","evidence":"I hereby revoke NSPM-5"},{"segment_id":"2","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines an immediate internal revocation, a mandatory later rescission by the Secretary of State of a list carrying legally consequential effects, a process-oriented regulatory direction to Treasury, and administrative savings clauses.","evidence":"the Secretary of State shall immediately rescind the list"}]}
